title: Stuffed sweet potato with black beans and soya yoghurt
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C, prick the sweet potatoes several times and bake for 40–45 minutes until soft.
Crumble the tofu and fry with the chopped onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the spices.
Add the rinsed beans, sweetcorn and diced tomato and warm through for 5 minutes, then season with lime juice and salt.
Split the sweet potatoes lengthways, fluff the flesh, fill and serve with soya yoghurt and coriander.
